name: Local Gaussian Process Signed Distance Field (L-GPDF)
definition: A temporary Gaussian Process Signed Distance Field formed by all GPs in the local VDB, modeling distance and surface properties separately for each leaf node.
summary: L-GPDF is a temporary, patch-based representation that enables fast, probabilistic distance queries by maintaining local Gaussian Process models for each VDB leaf node, avoiding the computational bottlenecks of global regression.
